_comment: Read by the apps to tell people on an older build that a newer one exists. The top block is for Android copies that were downloaded from this website: since October 2026 Android is on Google Play only, so it sends them there (download.html says how to move without losing anything). The Play and Microsoft Store builds never read this file.
notes: MPTree for Android now comes from Google Play, which keeps it up to date.
Export a backup first: Settings, Backup & Restore.
Then uninstall this copy, install MPTree from Google Play, and restore the backup.

windows._comment: The Windows app reads this block instead of the top one (Desktop/src/updateCheck.ts).
notes: Personalise: a style for the whole window, seen before you keep it.
Crop a cover to fit when you set one.
Shuffle and repeat each have their own button.
